WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate) as avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) as mean_rate
  FROM pair_averages
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    pa.orderslink,
    pa.acctscope,
    pa.avg_feerate,
    pa.avg_feerate - om.mean_rate as excess
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE pa.avg_feerate > om.mean_rate
),
ranked_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    avg_feerate,
    excess,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink ASC) as rank
  FROM filtered_pairs
)
SELECT
  orderslink,
  acctscope,
  avg_feerate,
  excess,
  rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank;

assumptions.assumption: The mean of all pair averages is unweighted—each pair's average counts equally regardless of how many fees it contains—rather than weighted so each fee contributes equally to the overall mean.
